root_turn.title: Lean governance closure and workflow retirement

objective: Commit GOV-01-S03, retire the W00A1a pull-request workflow and universal required-check claims, align active governance prose with manual exact-head control, preserve W00A1a evidence, and close governance implementation without adding product or executable behavior.
activated_user_visible_capability: None; governance documentation and workflow retirement only.
activated_invariants: Joseph removed project-integrity and turn-handoff-integrity from universal required status checks before the root turn.
Structural GitHub protections remain active with an empty bypass list.
W00A1a validator, tests, schema, registry, handoffs, and evidence remain byte-identical to the approved base.
The W00A1a GitHub Actions workflow is deleted and no workflow is added.
Active governance requires task-specific CI, ChatGPT exact-head review, Joseph exact-head approval, and a separate match-head merge-only turn.
Legacy review and owner-authorization schemas/templates remain historical rather than active merge gates.
No production code, tests, schemas, dependencies, product work, cloud work, or billable action is added.
activated_data_stores: Git repository and GitHub pull-request metadata only.
activated_adapters: Existing authenticated GitHub CLI in read/task-branch mode only.
required_tests: The design supplement is indexed, hash-matched, and committed before activation.
The activation validates against the existing activation schema and its sidecar matches.
gh ruleset check for the default branch no longer lists project-integrity or turn-handoff-integrity as required.
Structural pull-request, conversation, linear-history, force-push, deletion, squash-only, and no-auto-merge posture is recorded.
The retired workflow is absent and no workflow is added.
W00A1a validator, tests, schema, registry, handoffs, and evidence are byte-identical to the approved base.
Active governance documents contain no current claim that a universal review or owner-record check must pass.
The GOV-01 package manifest and artifact checksum verify after the approved edits.
The existing general handoff schema validates the W00C JSON handoff.
git diff --check, git fsck --full, and clean-worktree checks pass.
required_evidence: Exact design, activation, implementation, and live handoff SHAs.
Changed-file ledger and W00A1a preservation comparison.
Zero-code, zero-workflow-addition, zero-schema-addition, zero-dependency complexity receipt.
Open draft PR, concise W00C handoff pair, and completion comment.
explicit_non_goals: No universal validator, static analyzer, policy engine, parser, dependency inference, or trusted-live workflow.
No owner-authorization record/check, protected environment, merge automation, or dummy merge proof.
No source acquisition, benchmark execution, biblical domain, database, archive, runtime, retrieval, model, UI, cloud, Lambda, Luna, training, evaluation, or billable work.
No repair or reuse of any failed W00A1b or W00G implementation.
prohibited_scaffolding: No new workflow, schema, dependency, executable, test module, service, package, flag, TODO, or placeholder.
No modification of preserved W00A1a implementation or evidence.
No activation of VS01-T01 in this root turn.
completion_criteria: GOV-01-S03 and ACT-W00C-GOVERNANCE-CLOSURE-v1 are indexed, hashed, and committed.
The universal workflow and required-check claims are retired without weakening structural rules.
All active governance prose agrees on the lean exact-head merge sequence.
The package manifest/checksum are internally consistent.
The final commit contains only the W00C handoff pair.
The PR is open, draft, unapproved, and unmerged for ChatGPT exact-head review.
The honest substantive-line count is at most 400 and no prohibited scope exists.
